text: Red - Channel Islands Shipping Area Wind Warning Issued at 08:45 UTC Thursday 22 October 2026 S severe gale F9 with gusts to 60kt expected later veering W to NW storm F10 with gusts to 70kt later. When to expect this Imminent means 0 to 6 hours from time of issue Soon means 6 to 12 hours from time of issue Later means more than 12 hours from time of issue Impacts Disruption is expected. Avoid outside activity. Damage to moored boats is likely in exposed locations. Damage to infrastructure is possible. Check the latest weather forecast and advice from authorities.
